plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-codex-bridge

Observe and steer a local **Codex** (OpenAI) session from **DeepSeek Harness**.

The plugin talks to `codex app-server` — the same protocol the Codex app itself
uses — which is what makes the live parts possible at all:

| | Reading the rollout `.jsonl` | This plugin |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Transcript | after it is written | live deltas, plus polls |
| Reasoning | only what was flushed | summary deltas as they stream |
| Rate-limit budget | not present | `account/rateLimits/read` |
| Send a message | not possible | queue (the only cross-process path) |
| Answer an approval | not possible | only for turns this bridge started |

It was built as a DSH counterpart to a Codex session running in the Codex desktop
app: read what that session is doing, hand it the next instruction, and know
exactly which parts are impossible rather than guessing.

## Tools

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `codex_status` | Account, plan, rate-limit budget, local processes, latest thread, pending approvals. Degrades to a readable message when Codex is not reachable instead of throwing. |
| `codex_threads` | Recent threads, optionally filtered by a search string. |
| `codex_transcript` | Items of one thread, newest first. |
| `codex_watch` | Watches a thread for N seconds and returns what streamed past, merging the live notification stream with transcript polls and labelling each event's `source`. |
| `codex_send` | `queue` (default), `turn`, or `steer`. Falls back to the queue when the desktop app holds the thread's write lock. |
| `codex_approvals` | Lists pending approval requests and answers them. |
| `codex_queue` | Shows the messages still waiting on a thread (`action=list`), and cancels one with `action=delete`. Reports what the app-server confirmed, since a live session usually consumes a queued message first. |
| `codex_budget` | Reads the rate-limit buckets and says whether Codex is out of quota, quoting the server's own flags. A high `usedPercent` is a level, not a limit, so 100% is not reported as "out of quota". |
| `codex_ask` | One question on a throwaway Codex thread, with a chosen model and effort, then hands the answer back into a development thread verbatim (`feed:false` to only read it). It is the DSH↔Codex quick-chat path; a model override that Codex declines fails the call instead of quietly asking the default model. |
| `codex_handoff` | Builds a takeover brief out of the thread's own records — the objective, the instruction quoted verbatim, what it touched, where it stopped, the quota at that moment, and what the brief cannot know. `saveTo` writes it to a file. `action: "prepare"` writes it as a **takeover** of a thread whose quota is gone; `action: "claim"` records that a person or this session has actually taken it over. |

## Board

The same projection is also a panel inside Harness: a sidebar row named **Codex**
opens a board whose columns are **Needs you** (red), **Blocked** (orange),
**Running** (green) and **Nothing observed** (grey), in that order — the four
states live in `src/task-state.js`, one rule per state.

Every judgement is made on the host, in pure functions, so the panel cannot invent
a status the protocol never reported. Each card shows the state, whether it was
`reported` or `inferred`, the reasons behind it, the evidence it rests on, the
newest recorded turn statuses as a strip, and a progress bar **only when Codex
reported a denominator** (a goal's token budget, or plan steps). With no
denominator the card shows the counts it really has and says
`no progress denominator reported` instead of drawing a bar from nothing.

Six rules keep it honest:

- A thread holding an approval this connection is responsible for is **Needs you**,
  and it is never filed under Blocked even when it also has queued messages.
- *Running* means Codex reported the turn as advancing, **or** this bridge's
  connection saw `turn/started` and has not seen it finish, **or** the rollout was
  touched seconds ago — and that last case is printed as `inferred`. The fourth
  column is **Nothing observed**, never "idle": silence from a connection-scoped
  protocol is not proof that nothing is happening.
- Every card carries a **last** line: the newest item the rollout reports that is not
  encrypted reasoning, with that item's own status printed verbatim. It reports what
  the thread last did; it is not a claim that a turn is running.
- Age is part of the judgement, not decoration, and the age is the **turn's own
  end time** (`completedAt`), never when the thread was last touched — opening a
  thread, or restarting Codex, bumps `updatedAt` and would otherwise make a
  day-old failure look new. A failed turn is **Needs you** while it is fresh; on a
  thread with no goal, a failure older than `FAILURE_ATTENTION_MS` (48 hours)
  keeps its error text as evidence and the card settles to grey. The board's first live run was three red cards whose failures
  were seconds, 3.6 days and 12.8 days old, and only the first wanted anything —
  a red column that never empties is one people stop reading. The same failure on a
  thread that still carries a goal stays red at any age, because the goal is Codex's
  own standing statement about work that is meant to be running.
- Queue, item, turn and goal inspection are sampled (a bounded number of threads per
  refresh, all of it reported in the snapshot's `probe` block), and the board says so
  rather than presenting a partial read as a total.
- The account line and the quota line come from the same predicate as
  `codex_budget`, and a reached quota is a warning that quotes the server's flag.

### When Codex runs out: prepare, then claim

A reached quota is the one failure nothing here retries — it is not a run that
stopped, it is an account that ran out, and a red card that can never change is one
people stop reading. So a quota card offers **Prepare a takeover**: the plugin writes
the handoff brief to `<project>/.codex-handoff/<threadId>-<time>.md` and the card says
so.

**A prepared brief is not a handover, and the panel keeps saying so.** The plugin
cannot push into a Harness conversation, so `claimed` may only be set by an explicit
`codex_handoff action=claim` (or the card's **Mark taken over** button). Until then
the card reads *takeover prepared, unclaimed*, with that sentence attached. The
records live in memory for the run; the file is on disk for whoever looks next.

The panel's controls are almost all reads, and exactly one of them can reach Codex.
**Refresh** re-reads the snapshot. **Takeover brief** renders the same markdown
`codex_handoff` builds, with Copy and Close buttons. **Pause this thread** /
**Resume this thread** stops the autopilot from touching that one thread. **Prepare
a takeover** and **Mark taken over** drive the local takeover store — the first only
where a card is actually asking, the second only after the first. **Evaluate one
pass** runs a single autopilot pass through the same guards, so with the autopilot
off it writes nothing.

**Keep Codex moving for 30m** is the one that arms the autopilot. While armed, and
only then, a host-side timer may queue a continuation message into a **Blocked**
thread, or into a **Needs you** thread whose failure the supervisor can read as
transient, through `thread/queue/add` — the same single write `codex_send` uses.

### What it sends

Not a bare "continue". Every automatic message is a **supervision brief** built from
that thread's own record — and only from it: the goal objective Codex was given,
Codex's own last `agentMessage` word for word (with its phase), the newest turn's
status and, when it failed, the error text Codex recorded plus how long ago that was,
the item counts for the turn, and whether a queue is still unconsumed. Nothing is
paraphrased and nothing is invented; where the record is empty the brief says so
(`这个线程没有记录目标`, `没有留下可读的回复文字`).

### Resume, do not replay

Before a supervised message is sent, the thread's working directory is read with
`git status --porcelain` (read-only, 5s, never fatal). A resume is not a re-run: if
the directory already carries uncommitted work — or the failing turn recorded file

plugins.description: Right-click menu for the DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web GUI: open a workspace project or file reference in the file manager, and a link in the external browser. ｜ 为 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Web GUI 补上右键菜单：工作区项目与文件引用在资源管理器中打开，链接在外部浏览器中打开。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-right-click-menu

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Right-click support for the DSH Web GUI. Right-clicking a **file reference** reveals it
in the file manager; right-clicking a **link** opens it in the external browser;
right-clicking a **workspace project** in the left sidebar opens that directory.

## Why it is needed

The desktop shell builds its right-click menu in the Electron main process
(`lib/main.js`), and only for two cases:

```js
window.webContents.on("context-menu", (_event, { isEditable, selectionText, editFlags }) => {
  const items = [];
  if (isEditable) items.push(/* undo, redo, cut, copy, paste, select all */);
  else if (selectionText.length > 0) items.push({ role: "copy" });
  if (items.length > 0) Menu.buildFromTemplate(/* … */).popup({ window });
});
```

An empty `items` array means no menu is shown at all. So right-clicking a Markdown link,
an `@` file reference, a delivery card, or a right-Sidebar file-tree row currently does
nothing. This plugin claims those right-clicks in the page and offers the two actions the
product already knows how to perform.

## What it does

| Right-clicked element | Menu rows |
|---|---|
| HTTP(S) link — Chat/assistant Markdown, inline-code URLs | **Open in external browser** · Copy link address |
| File reference — Markdown file link, `@path` chip, delivery card, file-tree row, document path label | **Show in File Explorer** · Copy file path |
| Directory — left-sidebar workspace project, `@folder/` chip, file-tree directory row, file-tree header | **Show in File Explorer** · Copy folder path |

Labels follow the active UI language. The plugin registers a Simplified Chinese dictionary
(`在外部浏览器中打开`, `在资源管理器中打开`, `复制文件路径`, `复制文件夹路径`) beside the English one, so it
reads correctly under either locale.

Every other right-click is left exactly as it was: editable fields keep the native
undo/cut/copy menu, and a text selection keeps the native copy menu. The menu is the
shared `Menu` primitive, so ordering, keyboard navigation (arrows, Tab, Escape), focus
return, outside-click dismissal, and theme integration are the product's own.

### Screenshots

Captured in the Chinese UI; the labels follow whichever language is active.

| Link | File reference | Workspace project |
|---|---|---|
| ![Right-click menu on a link](docs/menu-link.png) | ![Right-click menu on a file reference](docs/menu-file.png) | ![Right-click menu on a project in the left sidebar](docs/menu-workspace.png) |

### How each action is carried out

- **Open in external browser** reuses the product's own external-navigation carrier:
  `window.open(url, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer")`. The Electron main process
  intercepts `_blank` window opens and hands the URL to `shell.openExternal`, so this is
  the same path a plain Chat link click takes.
- **Open in the file manager** uses the Session Remote `session.openWorkspacePath`, and
  the request depends on what was clicked — the same split the product's own directory
  and file controls make:
  - a **directory** is opened in the file manager itself (`{ path }`, no `action`), so a
    workspace project browses to its contents rather than being highlighted inside its
    parent;
  - a **file** is revealed where it already lives (`{ path, action: "reveal" }`), because
    "open in the file manager" must not mean "launch this file's own application".

  Either way the Host re-verifies the path through the composed filesystem before asking
  the desktop, so the plugin never touches the filesystem itself and cannot escape the
  Session's access.

The second row names what the target actually is — `Copy file path` for a file and
`Copy folder path` for a directory (`复制文件路径` / `复制文件夹路径` in Chinese). Which row set a
target gets comes from the pure `menuRowsFor(target, t)`, so that wording is asserted
without a renderer.

The Session Remote resolves a relative path against the Host process directory, so the
plugin makes the path absolute first — from the left sidebar's Workspace list (the
project row carries only the Workspace id), from the file tree's own `data-files-root`,
or from the retained main-view Session's `cwd` for workspace-relative Markdown links.

## Layout

```
package.json             bundle + plugin declaration (`dsh.bundle`, `dsh.client`)
cordis.patch.yml         the one Loader row this bundle inserts
lib/index.js             host half — empty `apply`, this is a pure UI plugin
lib/client.js            browser half — the whole feature
test/detection.test.mjs  dependency-free tests
scripts/live-bundle.mjs  live check against a running Host
```

`lib/client.js` is authored directly in the module system's factory-CJS form
(`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`), exactly as a built client bundle is, so
the package needs no build step. Its only module requests are `react`,
`react/jsx-runtime`, and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` — all three are part of
the shell's frozen platform module table.

## Development

No build step, no dependencies, no test framework:

```sh
npm test              # node test/detection.test.mjs
npm run check:live    # node scripts/live-bundle.mjs [baseUrl]
```

`npm test` loads `lib/client.js` the way the module system does (stubbed platform
modules), asserts the factory face and the slot/dictionary registrations, then *extracts
the bundle's own pure sections out of the shipped source* and exercises them against a
simulated DOM built from the markup each DSH surface really renders — so the tests cannot
drift from a copy of the code.

`npm run check:live` reproduces the Host's `artifactRevision` (`framedHash` over
`mtimeMs`/`ctimeMs`/`size`), requests the combo route
`/plugins/??<name>/client.js&rev=<rev>`, and asserts the response starts with the bytes on
disk. It defaults to `$DSH_WEB_URL` or `http://127.0.0.1:19387`; the plugin name and bundle
path come from this package's own `package.json`.

Editing `lib/client.js` needs no rebuild: the Host derives bundle revisions from file
metadata, so a saved file reaches an open page through client HMR.

## Compatibility

Built and verified against **DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`** (desktop runtime, Electron web GUI).

This is a **Web-surface** plugin. It needs the Web composition — a page to attach a
document listener to. Under the headless or SDK profiles there is no browser half at all,
so the plugin is inert rather than broken.

The plugin deliberately relies on public plugin surfaces — `ctx.slots`, `ctx.locale`, the
Session Remote `session.openWorkspacePath`, the client Workspace list, and the
`dsh-client-ui-primitives` exports `Menu`/`Toast`/icons. It has no private copy of any of
them.

Detection, however, reads markup that DSH does not publish as an API. These are the
fragile points, all in one place (`filePathOf` in `lib/client.js`) and all covered by
tests, but they can move with a DSH release. A right-click is claimed by the first signal
found walking outward from the pointer, so a nested icon or label reaches its own control:

| # | Signal | Resolves to |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `<a href="http(s)://…">` | URL |
| 2 | `data-row-key="workspace:<id>"` — left sidebar project row | directory, from `ctx.workspaces.list` |
| 3 | `data-files-path` / `data-files-root` / `data-files-entry` — right Sidebar file tree | file or directory |
| 4 | `data-ref-chip` = `file`/`folder`, a Markdown file-link class, or a button/link tooltip naming an absolute path | file or directory |

The package also declares `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peers for the runtime it targets, so DSH
refuses it on an unverified version rather than loading a menu that no longer matches the
DOM. If an upgrade does stop the menu appearing, `npm test` narrows it down: the failing
case names the surface, and the fix is a row in that table.

## Install

Install the package into the profile that serves the GUI. The supported route is the
plugin manager, which adds the dependency and appends the bundle to the profile's
`dsh.profile.bundles`:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle  target: <spec>
```

Or by hand, from the profile directory:

```sh
pnpm add <spec>
```

then append the name to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile's `package.json`.

plugins.readme_text: # dsh-theme-button 给 **DeepSeek Harness** 桌面版加一个悬浮主题挂件：切换官方外观，以及设置一层自定义背景。 挂件浮在界面之上，可以拖到任何位置并记住位置。所有界面自带半透明毛玻璃效果。 ## 效果展示 | 自定义背景：关闭 | 自定义背景：纯色 | | --- | --- | | | | | 自绘取色器 | 自定义背景：图片 | | --- | --- | | | | 面板、挂件、取色板都是半透明毛玻璃，只在自定义背景开启时生效。 ## 功能 | 功能 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | 悬浮挂件 | 默认在右下角，可拖动；位置自动记住；轻点开关面板，拖动时自动收起面板 | | 官方外观 | 浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统，写回 DSH 官方外观设置，不是插件自己的一套 | | 自定义背景 | 纯色（6 个预设 + 自绘取色器）或图片（最多 6 张），二选一 | | 背景参数 | 不透明度、模糊、亮度、饱和度，图片与纯色各有独立的不透明度 | | 适配方式 | 填充 / 适应 / 平铺 / 拉伸 | | 毛玻璃 | 挂件、面板、取色板三者一致；关闭自定义背景即恢复 DSH 原生外观 | ## 环境要求 - DeepSeek Harness 桌面版（Windows） - 无需额外依赖 ## 安装 先取得插件文件，再让 DSH 加载它。 ### 方式一：本地链接安装（推荐） 把插件文件夹放到一个**固定的位置**（装好后不要再移动），然后执行： ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:C:\dsh-plugins\dsh-theme-button ``` ### 方式二：从发布包安装 1. 解压发布包到一个固定位置，例如 `C:\dsh-plugins\dsh-theme-button` 2. 在该目录下运行： ```powershell .\install.ps1 ``` 或者手工执行上面那条 `dsh plugin ... add link:` 命令。 ### 完成后必须重启 **请完全退出并重新启动 DSH。** 插件的宿主部分只在启动时加载，仅刷新页面不够。 ### 验证安装成功 重启后应该看到右下角出现一个调色板图标按钮。也可以访问： - `http://127.0.0.1:/dsh-theme-button/version` —— 应返回一个版本号 ## 使用方法 ### 挂件 | 操作 | 效果 | | --- | --- | | 轻点 | 打开 / 关闭设置面板 | | 按住拖动 | 移动挂件位置，鼠标变为抓手，面板自动收起；松手后位置自动保存 | | 位置 | 重开 DSH 后保持上次位置；不会超出屏幕，也不会进入窗口按钮那一行 | ### 官方外观 面板第一段是「外观」，三选一：浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统。选择会同步到 DSH 官方外观设置，与官方设置页双向一致。 ### 自定义背景 面板第二段是「自定义背景」，总开关默认**关闭**。 打开总开关后，选择背景来源： - **纯色**：点色板里的预设，或点最右边的方块打开取色器自定义 - **图片**：点「添加图片」选图，最多 6 张；点缩略图切换，点缩略图上的 × 删除 图片放满 6 张后，「添加图片」会自动变灰禁用；删掉一张即恢复。 ### 取色器 | 操作 | 效果 | | --- | --- | | 上方方形区域 | 拖动手柄调整饱和度与明度 | | 中间彩色条 | 拖动手柄调整色相，圆环中显示当前选中的颜色 | | 底部输入框 | 手动输入颜色值，回车或点击别处即生效 | | ▴ ▾ 按钮 | 在 HEX / RGB / HSL 三种格式之间切换 | 输入时三种格式都认：即使当前显示的是 HEX，直接输入 `rgb(255, 0, 0)` 也会按 RGB 解析。 ### 参数说明 | 参数 | 范围 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | 不透明度（图片） | 0–10 | 图片的显示强度，0 等于关闭整个效果 | | 不透明度（纯色） | 0–10 | 纯色独立的一份，与图片那份互不影响 | | 模糊 | 0–24px | 背景的模糊程度，默认 0 | | 亮度 | 0–10 | 5 为 100%，即不做调整 | | 饱和度 | 0–10 | 5 为 100%，即不做调整 | ### 适配方式 | 方式 | 效果 | | --- | --- | | 填充 | 铺满整个区域，超出部分裁掉（默认） | | 适应 | 完整显示整张图，可能留边 | | 平铺 | 按原尺寸重复平铺 | | 拉伸 | 拉伸到铺满，会变形 | ## 首次安装的默认值 | 项目 | 默认值 | | --- | --- | | 挂件位置 | 右下角 | | 外观 | 跟随系统 | | 自定义背景 | 关闭 | | 背景来源 | 未选择 | | 取色器颜色 | `#8FB3A5` | | 图片 | 无 | | 适配方式 | 填充 | | 不透明度 | 5 / 10 | | 模糊 | 0px | | 亮度 / 饱和度 | 5 / 10（100%） | 设置保存在本机浏览器存储中，重开 DSH 后全部沿用（面板的开 / 关状态除外）。 ## 卸载 ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-theme-button ``` 然后重启 DSH。如果还要清掉本机保存的设置，见「常见问题」最后一条。 ## 常见问题 **挂件没有出现** 确认已经**完全重启** DSH，而不是只刷新页面。再访问 `/dsh-theme-button/version` 看是否返回版本号。 **背景效果看不见** 先确认「自定义背景」总开关是打开的，且不透明度不为 0。 **侧边栏 / 某个区域没有效果** 少数情况下背景层需要界面自身发生变化才会重新计算。切换一下图片或颜色，或打开一个新会话即可恢复。 **改了插件文件没有生效** `lib/client.js`（界面部分）会自动重载，但同一版本 10 秒内最多重载 3 次，超过请手动刷新页面。`lib/index.js`（宿主部分）必须重启 DSH。 **想恢复出厂设置** 打开开发者工具，执行下面这行后刷新页面： ```js localStorage.removeItem('dsh-theme-button.state.v2') ``` ## 反馈问题 **这个项目不保证持续更新**，所以反馈的意义不是"让我去改"，而是**把问题记录下来**： 让后来遇到同样情况的人能在这里搜到答案，也让将来想接手的人知道有哪些坑。 所以无论你只是想说一句"这里好像不对"，还是发现了具体的 Bug，都欢迎告诉我： | 请提供 | 在哪看 | | --- | --- | | 你做了什么操作 | 越具体越好 | | 期望的结果 / 实际的结果 | 分别是什么 | | 插件版本 | `package.json` 里的 `version`，或访问 `/dsh-theme-button/version` | | DSH 版本 | DSH 的「关于」页 | | 截图 | 最有效，能省很多来回 | **联系方式** - **邮箱：`zhanghz1130@outlook.com`**（标题里带上 `dsh-theme-button`，方便我归档） - **GitHub Issues**：[提交 Issue](../../../issues) —— 推荐用这个，问题公开留存，别人能直接看到 **我不承诺一定会修**，但会尽量看一眼。如果问题只影响你的个别情况，也欢迎自行修改—— MIT 许可，随便改、随便发。 ## 已知限制 - 只支持 Windows 桌面版 DSH（边框预留区的处理依赖 Windows 窗口变量） - 取色器与面板都绘制在自己的浮层里，不会与 DSH 原生菜单抢占最上层：DSH 自己的菜单和对话框会盖住它们 - 图片上限 6 张，且受浏览器存储容量限制 ## 项目文件 | 文件 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `package.json` | 插件清单 | | `cordis.patch.yml` | 让 DSH 在启动时加载本插件 | | `lib/index.js` | 宿主部分：注册路由、注入页面脚本、读写外观偏好 | | `lib/client.js` | 界面部分：挂件、面板、取色器、背景效果 | | `install.ps1` | 安装辅助脚本 | | `LICENSE` | 许可协议 | `_dev/` 是开发资料（历史备份与补丁脚本），不参与分发，可以删除。 ## 开发 ```powershell # 打包：只收集该分发的文件，输出到 dist/ .\pack.ps1 ``` 改完 `lib/client.js` 后页面会自动重载（它每 2.5 秒检查一次版本号）；改完 `lib/index.js` 需要重启 DSH。 代码里有较多注释，说明了每一处设计的取舍；遇到疑问也欢迎直接[反馈](#反馈问题)。 ## 关于这个项目 这个插件是**用 AI 辅助完成的**。我本人不是程序员，没有独立写出这些代码的技术能力， 但我投入了大量时间去提需求、试效果、找问题、反复验证，也承担了 AI 开发工具的费用。 > **项目状态**：功能已完整可用。我**不承诺持续更新**——它现在够用，我就不一定继续折腾了。 > 代码是 MIT 许可，任何人都可以自己改、自己发。 如果你觉得它好用，欢迎请我喝杯水。感谢你的支持！ ### 感谢支持 --- ## 许可 MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: Balance and per-session spend HUD for DeepSeek Harness, with budget alerts, peak-hour warnings and opt-in official price sync.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# dsh-balance-hud

An always-on HUD in the bottom-right corner of the **DSH (DeepSeek Harness)** Web GUI that shows your
DeepSeek **account balance** and the **cost of the current session**.

[简体中文说明](README.zh-CN.md) · [Design notes](docs/DESIGN.md) · [设计说明](docs/DESIGN.zh-CN.md) · [LICENSE](LICENSE)

![The two states of the HUD: a collapsed corner badge and the expanded detail panel](assets/preview-en.png)

> **About these images:** they are not photographs of a live DSH window. They are renders of the
> plugin's own layout and colours, driven by its real style values and real figures — a capture tool
> for the running GUI was not available when they were made. Treat them as a faithful layout
> reference, not as evidence of a running install. Pull requests replacing them with genuine
> screenshots are welcome.

- **Account balance** — recharge balance + bonus balance, read through the same service the
  *Settings → Account & balance* page uses (`ctx.deepseekAccount.getBalance()`).
- **Two cost figures** — a token-based *estimate* from the official price table, and an *actual*
  figure accumulated from real balance decreases (external reductions excluded).
- **External balance changes, both ways** — a top-up raises the balance, and a lapsed bonus grant is
  reclaimed by the platform; money moving in or out externally never touches the spending counter.
- **Per session** — the tracker is keyed by session id; refreshing the page or switching sessions
  never damages or clobbers another session's record, because the read → modify → write round trip
  is lossless.
- **No credentials, and no outbound network unless you opt in** — the plugin never touches your API
  key. It reaches the network only after you turn price syncing on (see
  [Prices and syncing](#prices-and-syncing)); until then it makes zero external requests.
- **Two halves, one relay** — a browser half renders the HUD; a Host half exposes read-only loopback
  HTTP routes (balance, bonus signal, price sync, model list), so the browser itself never talks to
  anything but loopback.
- **Configurable, and budgeted** — a preference row in *Settings → General* sets the model, the poll
  intervals, the budgets and the warnings; the card gains a coloured edge as spending approaches a
  budget, and the panel counts down to the next peak/off-peak switch.

```bash
# Windows — double-click tools\install.cmd, or:
tools\install.cmd

# macOS / Linux:
sh tools/install.sh
```

Both launchers find Node for you — including **the runtime DSH already ships**, which is not on
`PATH`. If your machine has no Node at all, they say so and tell you what to do, instead of failing
with `node: command not found`. Install into a different profile with `--profile <dir>`, preview with
`--dry-run`, undo with `--uninstall`.

Prefer to run it yourself? The plain form assumes Node is on `PATH`:

```bash
node tools/install.mjs    # install into ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop, then restart DSH
node tools/smoke.mjs      # offline smoke suite (83 assertions), no DSH install needed
```

**Then restart DSH.** Adding a plugin changes the profile's bundle list, which is not hot-reloaded;
a page refresh alone will not pick it up.

## The HUD

```text
                                                        ┌──────────────────────────────┐
                                                        │  Balance             ¥43.42  │
                                                        │  Session est.         ¥0.59  │
                                                        └──────────────────────────────┘
```

Hovering the card expands a detail panel: balance rows (recharge / bonus / total), the three priced
components of the estimate, the actual figure, token counts, and — with parallel sessions — the
apportionment rows (`Session share`, `Other sessions`, `Tracked sessions`, `Account total`). The
panel uses 4 decimals; the card uses 2. The interface ships in **Chinese and English** and follows
DSH's language by default; the English names below are what each row means.

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Balance | Total account balance (recharge + bonus), 2 decimals |
| Session est. | Estimate for the current session; 2 decimals on the card, 4 in the panel; `—` when the session has no token usage yet |
| Actual charged | Accumulated real spending for this session (single session; becomes `Session share` when parallel) |

Amounts below the smallest displayed unit render as `<¥0.01` on the card and `<¥0.0001` in the
panel, so real spending is never rounded down to a flat zero.

## Interaction

- **Hover** the card and the detail panel expands; move away and it closes.
- The card and the panel are separate elements with an intentional **8 px gap** between them, and the
  pointer must be able to cross that gap without the panel closing. The hover decision is attached to
  the card and the panel themselves — each has its own enter/leave handler — never to the enclosing
  positioning container. A **140 ms** pending-close timer carries the card's `mouseleave` across the
  gap so the panel's `mouseenter` cancels it.
- Leaving the **left** edge of the card *or* the **left** edge of the panel closes the panel. This is
  deliberate: the container reserves extra space above and to the sides, so hanging the close
  behaviour on the container box would keep the panel open over dead space.
- **Click** the card to fold it down to a small corner badge showing 2 cells — label and balance;
  click again to restore it.
- **Keyboard:** the card is a `role="button"` with `tabIndex=0` and toggles the fold on `Enter` and
  `Space`. The panel is a `role="dialog"`.
- The panel header carries a **Refresh** button that immediately shows a busy label and then an
  `Updated at HH:MM:SS` timestamp, plus the manual *I just topped up* button, which shows a querying
  state while it works.
- **There are deliberately no `title` attributes anywhere in the HUD.** A native browser tooltip
  appears as an opaque black box about a second after hover and covers the panel, so the summary
  lives in `aria-label` instead — asserted by the smoke suite as a regression guard.

## Settings

The plugin contributes **one preference row** — `余额与花费 HUD` — to the DSH slot
`settings.general.item`, which DSH declares as *"one preference row inside the General section — the
additive seat for a single setting that needs no page of its own"* (a whole page is
`settings.section`; the same slot carries DSH's own Language, link-opening and performance-usage
rows). Find it at **Settings → General → 余额与花费 HUD**. It does **not** take over a whole settings
page.

| Setting | Values | Default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Model (`计价模型`) | `deepseek-flash`, `deepseek-v4-pro` | `deepseek-flash` | Price table used for the estimate and the apportionment weights |
| Price auto-sync interval (`自动同步价格`) | off / 6 h / 24 h / 3 d / 7 d | off | Auto-sync cadence for the official price table; nothing runs until you pick one (see [Prices and syncing](#prices-and-syncing)) |
| Foreground poll interval (`前台刷新间隔`) | 30 / 60 / 120 / 300 s | 60 s | Balance poll cadence while the page is visible |
| Hidden interval (`后台（页面隐藏）`) | 30 / 60 / 120 / 300 s | 300 s | Balance poll cadence while the page is hidden |
| Peak-warning lead time (`峰前提醒`) | 5 / 10 / 15 / 30 min | 10 min | How early the peak/off-peak warning appears |
| Session budget (`本会话预算（元）`) | CNY, `0` = unset | 0 | Budget for this session's estimated spend |
| Daily budget (`每日预算（元）`) | CNY, `0` = unset | 0 | Budget for the Beijing-day confirmed spend |
| Show account total row (`显示账户级合计`) | on / off | on | `Account total` row in the panel when parallel sessions exist |

plugins.description: Agent 体检诊所 —— 用可复核证据诊断 Agent 使用体验问题
plugins.readme_text:
# agent-clinic · Agent 体检诊所

**装为 Skill**（一行命令，无需克隆、无需选位置、无需回答任何提问）：

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/1687210989/agent-clinic/main/install.sh | bash
```

**装为 DSH 插件**（侧边栏 → **插件** → **添加插件**，粘贴下面这行）：

```bash
https://github.com/1687210989/agent-clinic.git
```

> 装成插件后有侧边栏「🩺 体检」入口和全页面板。**装完必须完全退出并重启 Harness**——插件只在启动时装载。

> **你的 Agent 体检诊所。** 只读扫描本地 Agent 会话，用**可逐条复核的证据**诊断真实发生的使用体验问题（token 浪费、死循环、跨会话失忆、资产闲置），并为每个问题开出可执行的处方。

[![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.15-blue)]()
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)]()
[![smoke](https://img.shields.io/badge/smoke-345%2F345-brightgreen)]()
[![CI](https://github.com/1687210989/agent-clinic/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/1687210989/agent-clinic/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> `smoke N/N` 是**本地自检的通过数**（由 smoke 自己在跑完后核对，数字对不上就以退出码 1 结束）——
> 想知道 CI 此刻是红是绿，看旁边那枚 **CI** 徽章（它就是 GitHub Actions 的实况，改不了）。

---

## 它解决什么问题

大多数 Agent 使用分析工具只给你一堆统计数字，你看完也不知道该干什么。

agent-clinic 的做法不同：**它给证据，也给处方。**

- 不只说"你有死循环"，而是说"10 月 8 日这个会话，`list_agents` 用同样的参数失败了 4 次，在 `session.v4.jsonl.zstd#L101-L108`"——一条命令你就能自己复核。
- 不只给建议，而是给**可执行的动作**：能整段粘进 profile 的 YAML 片段、斜杠命令、已核实插件的安装入口，或明确说没有插件能解。
- **读你的真实配置**再开口：处方会说"你现在 `maxInlineTokens=12500`（随附默认，profile 未覆盖）→ 建议 6000"，而不是"建议调低一点"。当前值已经不弱于建议时，这条处方会被撤掉 —— **而且会写出来**（报告里的「已评估但未给出的处方」段会列出被撤的原因和当前值，你才能复核这个判断，不会以为"根本没有这条建议"）。
- **宁可承认做不到，也不假装有数据**：从未实现的维度一律列在报告里并写明原因。第二轮评估用原始日志证伪了旧的"数据源缺失"说法后，E3/N3/N4 从"不可实现"变成**已实现**；K1/K2 曾如实写成"隐私取舍下的方案未定"，2026-10-15 定案（写入本地加盐指纹快照）后也已实现 —— 现在报告里"尚未实现的维度"是**空的**，而这一节会保留并显示"没有"。
- **检索插件目录做针对性推荐**：按「能力标签 + 关键词」匹配你的问题，并说明**为什么推荐它**（例如"能力标签 token-saving 对上 C1；你的问题描述里出现了 token、消耗"）。目录有三个来源并逐一标出：**人工核实 / npm registry 同步 / GitHub 核实**（经 `gh-proxy.com` 中继 GitHub API，按 star 数与最近更新检索；API 不通时退回人工种子清单 + `git ls-remote`）。**已经装过的插件不再推荐**，**官方内置包单独标注**（通常已随 dsh-base 挂载）。热度（star / 下载量）如实展示，只用于同分排序、不参与对症打分。
- **面板里一切皆可折叠**：问题卡点开能看到证据与**挂在它下面的处方**；处方卡点开才展开分步操作、片段、风险与出处。
- **同类型合并**：同一指标在多个会话命中（或同一种模式出现多次）只会显示**一张卡**并标出「N 处」，展开后每一处仍保留自己的会话、结论与证据定位 —— 不重复展示，也不丢信息。

> **不做的事**：不主动推送、不代你安装、不改你的配置、不诊断代码质量、不把任何对话内容发到外部。

---

## 诊断维度

**22 项已实现**

| ID | 名称 | 判定 | 严重度 |
|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | token 消耗过快 | 会话**单位请求** output 超**其余主会话**基线 2 倍（基线逐会话排除自身；且总量 ≥2 万） | 高 |
| C2 | 上下文膨胀 | 末轮/首轮 input 增长 >10x 且 cacheRead <30% | 高 |
| C3 | 长会话疲劳 | 单会话消息数 >200 | 中 |
| C5 | 压缩可观测性 | 单会话压缩 ≥3 次，给出 **DSH 实测**释放 token（非估算） | 中 |
| C6 | 工具面成本 | 工具 schema >20000 字符（每请求重发）+ 窗口内 0 调用的工具 ≥5 个 | 中 |
| C7 | 上下文注入量 | 上下文被注入 ≥20 次且 ≥100000 字符 | 低 |
| E1 | 死循环 | 同工具 + 同参数 + 同错误，≥3 次 | 高 |
| E2 | 反复失败 | 会话工具错误率 >30% | 中 |
| E3 | 工具结果过大 | 单条工具结果 >8192 字符，会话内 ≥5 条 | 中 |
| E4 | 计划执行脱节 | 写计划后又大量调用工具，但 0 条完成 | 中 |
| E5 | 冗余重复调用 | 同工具 + 同参数 + 无错误，≥3 次 | 中 |
| N1 | 环境命令反复失败 | 命令类调用失败 ≥3 次 | 中 |
| N2 | 高风险操作 | 命令执行类工具命中 `rm -rf` / `--force` / `reset --hard` 等 | 高 |
| N3 | 权限审批摩擦 | 审批请求 ≥5 次（给出等待时长，以及**被拒 / 结果无法识别 / 无对应决定记录**三者分列） | 中 |
| N4 | API 重试频繁 | 模型请求重试 ≥3 次（给出失败码与累计退避） | 中 |
| A2 | skill 闲置 | 已装 skill 在 ≥30 天**日历窗口**内 0 次触发 | 中 |
| A3 | 高频手动序列 | **非通用工具**的两步序列 ≥5 次（去镜像、跨会话合并） | 低 |
| A4 | 子代理开销 | `delegationDepth>0` 会话 token 占比 >40% | 中 |
| A5 | 辅助 LLM 开销 | 辅助模型调用（联网检索 / 会话标题）≥20 次，给出 maxTokens 上界 | 中 |

> **C5/C6/C7/A5 是第三轮新增的"实测数据源"**（依据 `agent-clinic-待优化报告-DSH单平台.md`）：
> C1/C2 是**推断**浪费，而 DSH 自己就把**实测值**写进了日志 ——
> 压缩释放了多少 token（`shadowedTokenCount`）、工具 schema 多大、上下文注入多少、
> 辅助请求跑了几次。这四项**零隐私代价**（只记数字），
> 本机实测：压缩释放 **638,171** token、工具 schema **29,779** 字符/请求、
> 注入 **158,393** 字符、辅助调用 **96** 次。定义与阈值见 [docs/diagnostics.md](docs/diagnostics.md)。

**0 项排期中、0 项尚未实现** —— 最后两项（A1、K1/K2）都于 2026-10-15 实现：

| ID | 名称 | 判定 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | MCP 闲置 | profile patch 里已配置 MCP 服务器，但观察窗口（≥30 天）内工具名 `mcp__<serverName>__*` **0 次调用** | 配置驱动；窗口不足只报"还差多久"，证据指向**配置行号**（`show` 可展开） |
| K1 | 跨会话失忆 | 同一用户文本指纹出现在 **≥3 个**不同会话 | 需要加盐哈希快照 `~/.agent-clinic/text-fingerprints.json`（正文不落盘，`fingerprints --clear` 可删） |
| K2 | 已解决重新排查 | 同一指纹在 ≥2 个会话出现，较晚那次之后有失败/重试，而最早那次之后没有 | **软信号**：只给"低"+措辞"疑似" |

| ID | 名称 | 判定 | 隐私代价 |
|---|---|---|---|
| K1 | 跨会话失忆 | 同一用户文本指纹出现在 **≥3 个**不同会话（两次可能是正常追问） | 需要把**加盐哈希**写入本地快照 `~/.agent-clinic/text-fingerprints.json`（正文不落盘）；`agent-clinic fingerprints --clear` 可删、`AGENT_CLINIC_NO_FINGERPRINT_STORE=1` 可关 |
| K2 | 已解决重新排查 | 同一指纹在 ≥2 个会话出现，较晚那次之后有失败/重试，而最早那次之后没有（**软信号，只给"低"+措辞"疑似"**） | 同上 |

> K1/K2 曾长期挂在"尚未实现"里，理由写的是"隐私取舍、方案未定"。2026-10-15 你选了
> **写入本地快照**这一档，于是它们从"方案未定"变成已实现 —— 代价与边界见
> [docs/diagnostics.md](docs/diagnostics.md) 的实现状态一节。

> E3 / N3 / N4 曾经也被列在上面这张表里，理由是"DSH 数据源缺失"。
> 第二轮评估（[docs/evaluation-2026-10-14.md](docs/evaluation-2026-10-14.md)）拿原始日志逐条证伪：
> 数据一直都在，是适配层没抽 —— 现已全部实现（只补长度/编号/结论，不落正文）。

> **未检测到异常 ≠ 已确认无异常。** 样本不足时（如 A2 的 30 天窗口），
> 报告会写「样本不足，无法判定」，而不是混在「未检测到异常」里。

---

## 当前状态

| 统一事件模型 | ✅ 可用 |

| 证据层 `show` | ✅ 可用 |
| **诊断指标 22 项** | ✅ **可用**（见上表） |
| **处方层（可执行：配置片段 / 命令 / 插件 / 设置 / 行为）** | ✅ **可用**（读本机真实配置，给出「当前值 → 建议值」；被撤掉的处方会写明原因） |

| WorkBuddy 平台 | ⏳ 待实现 |

**M1 闭环已完成**：`./run.sh report` 产出带可复核证据 + 可执行处方的体检报告；DSH 插件有侧边栏入口、面板与准实时角标；冒烟测试 **345/345 通过**。

**输出示例**（2026-10-15 之前某次实跑的原文快照，数字随本机数据变化）：

plugins.description: Session trash for DeepSeek Harness: move conversations to a trash, restore them, or delete them permanently after a second confirmation.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-session-trash · Session Trash

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that adds **Move to trash** to each session's sidebar menu. Sessions are not deleted outright: they go to a trash, where you can **restore** them from Settings → Session trash, or **delete them permanently after a second confirmation**. The trash is never emptied automatically.

- DSH 0.2.x (`engines.dsh: >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`, including the 0.2.1-alpha previews)
- macOS and Linux; on Windows the plugin disables itself (the session write lock cannot be checked there)
- The official JSONL session storage only (the DSH default)

## Install

**Desktop**: open **Plugins** in the sidebar → **Add plugin**, enter one of the following, choose **Install**, then **Enable now** (a new plugin starts switched off):

- the GitHub address `https://github.com/ZZZZZZZ-ZZZZZ/dsh-session-trash`, or `github:ZZZZZZZ-ZZZZZ/dsh-session-trash#v0.2.1` for a fixed version
- the npm package name `dsh-plugin-session-trash`
- the absolute path of a local package such as `/path/to/dsh-plugin-session-trash-0.2.1.tgz` (made by `pnpm pack`)

The repository includes the built `lib/`, so a GitHub install runs no build script. If DSH cannot reach GitHub, use a network that can; the npm mirror DSH offers serves npm packages, not GitHub repositories.

Do not enter the source checkout: its `node_modules` holds development copies of DSH packages that would shadow the ones DSH runs.

**Command line** (optional): install Desktop's own `dsh` command from the application menu **Manage dsh Command…**, quit DSH completely, then run:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-session-trash
```

**Remove** it from the **Plugins** page, or quit DSH and run `dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-plugin-session-trash`. Sessions in the trash stay in `~/.dsh/session-trash/`; removing the plugin does not delete them.

## Use

1. In a session's "…" menu choose **Move to trash** and confirm; the session leaves the sidebar. A session opened in this run is hidden first and moves into the trash the next time DSH starts.
2. Open **Settings → Session trash**:
   - **Restore** puts the session back where it was, with its previous archive and pin state;
   - **Delete permanently** removes the local session logs after a second confirmation;
   - **Empty trash** deletes every entry after confirmation, stopping at the first failure.

## Safety

| Rule | Detail |
|---|---|
| Sessions in use are never moved | Running work (a turn, subagents, background jobs, schedules) refuses the move; so does a session another DSH process writes (its `session.lock` is held) |
| Opened sessions move at the next start | An idle session opened in this run is hidden at once (the official archive) and moves into the trash at the next DSH start, before any session opens; every check still applies then, and a move that cannot run waits for the following start. You can cancel it on the trash page meanwhile |
| Move, never copy | Moving to and from the trash is a same-volume `rename`; a trash on another volume refuses |
| No recursive removal | Permanent deletion unlinks only the files DSH writes in a session directory (log generations, publish temporaries, `session.lock`) and removes directories with non-recursive `rmdir`; any other file refuses the whole deletion |
| Path checks | Entry ids must be UUIDs; session directories and their parents must be plain directories (no symbolic links) that resolve inside the session root; the trash must not be inside the session root |
| Crash safety | A move is prepared in `.staging-<id>` and published by one rename; an interrupted move is rolled back at the next start |
| Authenticated calls | The browser calls through DSH's `/api` gateway (Typert Remote, connection-authenticated); no unauthenticated HTTP route is registered |
| Official APIs | Hiding and restoring use the registry's `archiveSession` / `unarchiveSession` / `pinSession`; DSH's own storage is never rewritten |

Subagent sessions move and restore with their parent; forks are independent conversations and stay. Project folders and workspace files are never touched.

## Configuration

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `trashDirectory` | `<DSH home>/session-trash` | Trash directory; outside the session root and on the same volume |

## Permanent deletion is local only

**Delete permanently** removes the copies on this machine. It cannot reach what DSH has already sent to DeepSeek:

- With the official DeepSeek API, DSH uploads the session log along with each request by default (the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-log-deepseek` plugin). Turning off **Settings → General → Upload Session Log when using the official model API** stops later uploads only; turning it back on also uploads what was recorded while it was off.
- Images sent to the official API are uploaded as files that DSH asks DeepSeek to expire after 7 days; DSH does not guarantee their remote deletion.

This plugin makes no network requests and sends nothing anywhere.

## Known limitations

- A session opened in this run moves into the trash only at the next DSH start (a plugin cannot safely release the write ownership DSH holds); until then it is hidden.
- Only session log directories are handled; attachments, caches, and spill files other features keep for a session stay where they are (see the Attachment Library below for attachment usage).
- Relies on the DSH 0.2.x JSONL directory layout; re-verify after a DSH major upgrade.

## Related plugin

**[Attachment Library · dsh-plugin-attachment-library](https://github.com/ZZZZZZZ-ZZZZZ/dsh-attachment-library)**: Session Trash handles session logs only; the images and files attached in conversations stay on this machine. Attachment Library is a read-only page (Settings → Attachment Library) that lists how much space every attachment takes and which conversations still use it, including those in the trash, and can show a file in Finder or open an image in Preview. With both plugins installed, the library counts conversations in the trash too.

Install: in **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter `github:ZZZZZZZ-ZZZZZ/dsh-attachment-library#v0.4.1`.

## Develop

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm test        # builds lib/ then runs every test
```

`lib/` is committed so a GitHub install can use it directly; after changing sources run `pnpm run build` and commit `lib/` with them.

The client tests render the real 0.2.0-rc.2 UI components from a DSH source checkout at `../dsh-0.2.0-rc.2` (tag `dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2`; see `tests/primitives-shim.ts`), because the published component build only runs inside the DSH page. Tests run against the DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 packages published on npm: real JSONL session storage, the real Workspace registry, and the real Typert gateway, with sessions generated in temporary directories.

plugins.description: Browse your Tripsy trips inside a DeepSeek Harness panel: itinerary, activities, lodging, transport and expenses, with times in each item's own timezone. Read-only by design -- create and edit by asking the agent.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tripsy

Browse your **[Tripsy](https://tripsy.app)** trips inside a DeepSeek Harness panel: itinerary, activities, lodging, transport and expenses — with the times converted into each item's own timezone.

[中文说明](README.zh-CN.md) | English

---

## What it does

A sidebar entry and a center-column page.

**＋ New trip** sits at the top of the trip list. Describe what you want in plain language — where, how long, who with, what you like — and the panel composes a detailed instruction that the agent turns into a real itinerary: the trip itself first, then activities, lodging and transport filled in day by day.

**Pick a trip** and it opens with two modules inside it:

- **行程浏览 / Browse** — a cover hero with the trip name, countdown, duration and date range; a day-grouped timeline with an icon per stop; and a cost card totalling each category from the items' own prices. Every time is rendered in its own IANA timezone.
- **AI 管理 / Manage** — describe the change you want, then press one button. The panel composes a precise instruction for that trip (id, dates and timezone included) and **sends it straight to the conversation**, so the agent starts working immediately and you watch every step. There is no prompt text to read and nothing to paste. If no conversation is open yet, the panel says so up front and the button falls back to copying the instruction.

**Your account details never reach the browser.** `/api/dsh-tripsy/health` returns only the auth summary and the account currency — not the name, e-mail or avatar the Tripsy profile carries.

```
┌ Tripsy ─────────────────────────────────┐
│ ┌ ＋ 新建行程 ─────────────────────────┐ │
│ │ 用一句话让 AI 生成行程                │ │
│ └──────────────────────────────────────┘ │
│ ┌──────────────────┬───────────────────┐ │
│ │ New York City    │ 行程浏览 │ AI 管理 │ │
│ │ 10-11 → 10-17    ├───────────────────┤ │
│ │ 东京周末         │  ╔═════════════╗  │ │
│ │                  │  ║    封面     ║  │ │
│ │                  │  ╚═════════════╝  │ │
│ │                  │  10月11日 星期日   │ │
│ │                  │  ● ✈️ LAX → JFK   │ │
│ │                  │  │ 🚗 驾车到酒店  │ │
│ │                  │  ● 🏨 Aman        │ │
│ └──────────────────┴───────────────────┘ │
└─────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ta-www/dsh-tripsy
```

Refresh the page. **Tripsy** appears in the sidebar. The first time, click **登录 Tripsy / Sign in** — the browser opens once for the OAuth handshake, and the token then refreshes itself indefinitely.

## Trip costs, completed by the agent

Tripsy's own expense reporting needs a paid plan, so the panel works from the prices already attached to activities, lodgings and transports. The **费用概览** card in each trip sums what has a price, and **AI 计算费用** hands the agent an instruction that completes it.

The split is deliberate. Summing prices is arithmetic, so it happens on the host, exactly, once, and is tested. Estimating what has *no* price is judgement, so it goes to the agent — with the real numbers attached, and told to adopt them rather than re-estimate, to say when it is unsure instead of inventing precision, and never to assume an exchange rate. Multi-currency sums are reported per currency and never silently added together.

The card is always rendered. Keying it on a non-empty price list hid it on exactly the trips that need it most — a real imported trip has 16 items and no prices at all.

The instruction asks the agent to research each unpriced item on named platforms (大众点评 / 美团 / 抖音团购 / 小红书 domestically; Google Maps, Tripadvisor, Yelp or official pages elsewhere; 12306, 航旅纵横 or airline sites for transport), to state the source and when it was checked, and to say "couldn't find it" with a range rather than invent a precise number with a fake citation. It reports a table first and writes the prices back only once that table is confirmed, so the card then shows real totals.

The prompt also states that nothing else about the trip may be added or deleted: filling in prices is the only permitted write.

## Export to your calendar (.ics)

Each trip has **导出到日历 / Export to calendar** next to its name, and a **教程 / Guide** button that opens the import steps right there — the two halves of "get this onto my phone" are useless apart.

`GET /api/dsh-tripsy/ics?id=<tripId>` returns a `text/calendar` file:

- the trip itself as one all-day event, with the end date written exclusively (+1 day) so the last day is not lost
- every activity, lodging and transport as its own event, with `LOCATION`, `GEO`, confirmation codes, prices and notes
- items without a start time are skipped, and the count is reported in `X-Tripsy-Skipped`

**Times are absolute UTC instants, not TZID-anchored wall times.** Anchoring to a named zone is only correct when the file also carries a `VTIMEZONE` with that zone's real transitions; hand-writing those gets DST wrong and shifts events by an hour. UTC cannot be misread by any calendar and keeps flight durations truthful. The local wall time is written into each description instead, so the itinerary still reads the way the booking does.

On iPhone: save the `.ics`, then hand it to a Shortcut (the community *ICS To Calendar* one, or three actions of your own: receive Files → Choose from Calendar → Add New Event) or just tap the file and let iOS ask which calendar to use.

## How it works

The host half registers a small route family and carries its own OAuth 2.1 + MCP client in `lib/tripsy/`, so installing the plugin needs no separate service and there is exactly one implementation of the OAuth dance and one place a token is refreshed.

| | |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | host half: `/api/dsh-tripsy/{health,trips,trip,login}` |
| `lib/client.js` | browser half: the sidebar row and the panel page |
| `lib/tripsy/*.mjs` | OAuth 2.1 (PKCE + dynamic client registration), Streamable HTTP MCP client |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | inserts the plugin row |

Credential at rest: `$DSH_HOME/tripsy-auth.json` (override with the `authFile` config). It is never sent to the browser — the panel only ever sees the data, never the token.

Requests are refused unless they come from loopback. Set `allowRemote: true` in the plugin config if you deliberately serve the UI over a LAN address.

## Configuration

```yaml
- id: ui-tripsy
  name: dsh-tripsy
  config:
    authFile: 'C:\Users\you\.dsh\tripsy-auth.json'   # where the token lives
    allowRemote: false                               # keep loopback-only
    enabled: true
```

## Notes

- Needs an active Tripsy account. Document attachments require Tripsy Pro; everything else works on a free account.
- Times are stored as UTC by Tripsy and rendered in each item's IANA timezone, which is what the upstream API expects clients to do.
- Unofficial community plugin, not affiliated with Tripsy.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Three-level source-text pins for DeepSeek Harness that survive context compaction: recall on demand, resident background, or highlighted constraints.
plugins.readme_text:
# highlightpin

[![Check](https://github.com/sbearbug/dsh-highlightpin/actions/workflows/check.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/sbearbug/dsh-highlightpin/actions/workflows/check.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

**Pin any selected passage; compaction cannot take it away.**

[中文](README.zh.md) · [Design](DESIGN.md) · [Evaluation](EVAL.md) · [Live evidence](docs/PROBES.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugin. Select any stretch of text in a conversation — a constraint, a number, a formula, a piece of code — and pin it with one click. From then on, no matter how the context is compacted, what the model receives is that **source text**, not a summary.

## Three levels

Each pin carries its own level:

| Level | Behaviour | Good for | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| **pin** (default) | Does nothing while the text is still in context; once compaction drops it, the extract text is re-inserted verbatim near the tail before the next request | Most pins | Never touches the system prompt, so it does not break the prefix cache on its own |
| **resident** | Lives in the system prompt with neutral wording: "consult it when relevant; no need to bring it up" | Important background: you want the model to match on it the moment it matters, without you mentioning it every turn | Costs one prefix-cache invalidation when you switch levels |
| **highlight** | Lives in the system prompt with emphatic wording: "follow it when relevant; if it conflicts with your latest explicit instruction, the latest instruction wins" | Constraints and priorities the model must keep honouring | Same as above; emphasis also raises how often the model brings it up on its own |

`resident` and `highlight` are deliberately two separate levels. "The model can always find it" and "the model always keeps it in mind" are different things, and emphasis has side effects of its own — so the choice is yours.

## Installation

From npm (published releases):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-highlightpin@0.1.2
```

Or straight from the GitHub source:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add 'https://codeload.github.com/sbearbug/dsh-highlightpin/tar.gz/v0.1.2'
```

On the web profile, replace `desktop` with `web`. After installing or upgrading, **fully quit and restart DSH**, then refresh the page, so that host and client both load the new version. Existing pins survive.

### Compatible DSH versions

`peerDependencies` declares `>=0.1.7-rc.1 <0.2.0-0 || >=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`. The DSH plugin manager checks these peers with `semver.satisfies(runtimeVersion, range, { includePrerelease: true })` and blocks installation and activation on a mismatch.

The range carries an explicit prerelease branch on purpose: under ordinary semver semantics a single `>=0.1.7-rc.1 <0.3.0-0` does not match the `0.2.0-rc.*` builds, because node-semver admits a prerelease only when some comparator in the range shares its exact `major.minor.patch` tuple and itself carries a prerelease tag.

| DSH version | Status |
|---|---|
| 0.2.0-rc.2 | **Verified live** — development and real-machine checks both ran on this version |
| 0.1.7-rc.1 / 0.1.7-rc.2 | **Offline suite passes**; CI re-runs the same suite against this line on every push |
| Other 0.2.x | Inferred from the APIs used, not verified individually |
| ≤ 0.1.6 | **Unsupported**: `CommandDefinitionId` does not exist at 0.1.5 and below, and the 0.1.6 line's session-event validation already differs |
| ≥ 0.3.0 | Not claimed |

## Usage

1. Select text inside **one** finished user or assistant message.
2. Click the pin above the composer.
3. Click the arrow beside it to open the details panel: switch each pin between "recall / resident / highlight", check budget usage, or unpin.

When you select inside a formula, the selection is expanded to the whole formula and what gets stored is the TeX source. Select the rendered $\nabla_\theta J(\theta)$ and the plugin stores `$\nabla_\theta J(\theta)$` — not the glyphs on screen. Selections inside code keep their indentation and line breaks.

Everything is also available from the command line:

| Command | Effect |
|---|---|
| `/hlpin list` | List every pin, its level and budget usage |
| `/hlpin last` | Pin the most recent assistant reply in full |
| `/hlpin show <n>` | Show one pin's full text |
| `/hlpin drop <n>` | Unpin |
| `/hlpin level <n> pin\|resident\|highlight` | Change a pin's level |

## Design notes

- **What is stored is source text, not screen text.** The client serialises the selection first (formulas back to TeX, copy buttons and line numbers stripped out), and the host then locates the matching source substring in the session log. Alignment reports one of three fidelities: `source-exact` (a clean hit), `source-normalized` (matched after whitespace and Markdown normalisation, but still storing a source slice), or `rendered` (no match — it stores the display text and **tells you so**).
- **`pin` only re-inserts after the original is gone.** Right after pinning, the text is already in context, so re-injecting it would be pointless. It comes back only once compaction has shadowed it — and at that moment the prefix cache was already invalidated. So the default level cannot break caching by construction.
- **The decision is a pure function that keeps no ledger.** Every step re-decides from "is this text still in context", and records nothing like "already re-inserted". A rejected step, a plugin restart, or the recall notice itself being compacted later therefore cannot lose a pin.
- **The resident section and the recall notice never duplicate each other.** Each step records which pins actually went into the system prompt for that step, and the recall path excludes them. With no such record it re-inserts as usual: better to duplicate than to lose.
- **Over budget means rejection, not truncation.** `pin`, `resident` and `highlight` each have their own character pool. Adding or promoting past a pool's budget is rejected outright with an error code; demotion is always allowed. The plugin never quietly truncates, evicts, or demotes a pin.
- **The session log format is left alone.** Pins live in the official `storageDomain`, and recall uses a message type the host already has, so a session can never become unloadable from an unknown event. The HTTP API is origin-checked and accepts JSON only from the local page.

The full set of trade-offs is in [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md).

## Verification status

- **Live**: "pin → `/compact` → next message" has been run end-to-end in DSH. The shadowed source text appeared in the next request's input, byte-identical to what was stored, with a matching SHA-256. Evidence: [docs/PROBES.md](docs/PROBES.md) and [docs/m1-live-0.1.4.json](docs/m1-live-0.1.4.json).
- **Offline**: alignment, selection serialisation, the decision function, all three injection paths, budgets, routes, commands and React interaction are covered by tests, run by CI on every push.


## Configuration

```json
{ "maxPinChars": 16000, "maxResidentChars": 6000, "maxHighlightChars": 2000, "holdSubagents": false }
```

| Setting | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `maxPinChars` | 16000 | Total source characters across `pin` pins |
| `maxResidentChars` | 6000 | Total source characters across `resident` pins |
| `maxHighlightChars` | 2000 | Total source characters across `highlight` pins |
| `holdSubagents` | `false` | Whether subagent sessions are covered too (off by default, to avoid wasting tokens) |

Characters are counted in UTF-16 units. Neither the number of pins nor the length of a single pin is capped; only the total per level is.

## Limitations

- Selections must stay within a single message; cross-message selections are not supported.
- Streaming messages, reasoning content and tool output are not supported.
- Pins belong to one session; forked sessions do not inherit them.
- One writer host per profile is supported.
- "Highlight" here is an emphasis level in the model input; it does not draw a visual highlight on the original message.


## Development

```sh
npm ci
npm run check   # build the client + run all te

plugins.description: Single-client session tabs preserving native sidebars and background work
plugins.readme_text:
# 轻量会话标签 / dsh-session-tabs

单客户端会话标签，复用 DSH 原生聊天视图和任务服务，保留左右侧栏及底部工作台。无 iframe，无运行时依赖。

[English](README_EN.md) · 版本 0.1.6 · MIT

[![verify](https://github.com/QIN-SMART/dsh-session-tabs/actions/workflows/verify.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/QIN-SMART/dsh-session-tabs/actions/workflows/verify.yml)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-session-tabs.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-session-tabs)

![合成会话中的标签栏与面板按钮](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QIN-SMART/dsh-session-tabs/main/docs/assets/session-tabs.png)

## 当前状态

**0.1.6 修复了 0.1.5 中打开插件管理等全局页面时整个窗口卡死的问题，建议 0.1.5 用户更新。**

已针对 DSH **0.2.0-rc.2** 验证，源代码采用 MIT 协议。DSH 的客户端 API 仍在演化，升级宿主后需要重新验收。

## 使用

- 原生左栏打开的会话自动加入顶部标签。点击标签切换，`＋` 使用原生新建会话。
- 当前标签与内容区使用同一亮色表面，通过两侧底部反向圆角衔接；其他标签在较暗背景上，悬停时标题和关闭按钮共用一块灰色底色。跟随 DSH 的亮/暗主题。
- `＋` 紧跟标签，与 `×` 图标居中对齐，旁边不再显示 `⋯`。底部工作区和右侧栏入口位于标签行右端，复用对应原生按钮的图标、状态和点击事件。右栏展开后，中央的打开入口隐藏，只保留窗口最右侧原生收起按钮；打开按钮采用相同的 28px 点击区域和 15px 图标。原生其他标题栏按钮保持原位。缺少原生入口时不显示对应按钮，切回原生视图或卸载时恢复原入口。
- 右栏开关位置在动画期间固定保留，底部按钮不会挤进来。收起时若原生打开入口尚未恢复，该位置暂时禁用；就绪后恢复点击。两个按钮均使用 28px 点击区域并居中对齐，底部图标沿用原生 16px。
- `×` 只关闭标签，不删除、归档或停止会话。运行或待确认的会话在后台保留，结束后释放额外引用。
- 左栏底部的「标签窗口」线条图标用于显示/隐藏标签，悬停显示目标视图名称。焦点在标签栏内时，`⌘/Ctrl + Shift + T` 可恢复本次打开窗口内刚关闭的标签；输入框不拦截此快捷键。
- 拖动调整顺序；标签获得焦点后，左右方向键切换，`Alt + Shift + 左/右` 调整顺序。输入框没有新增全局快捷键，中文组字不受拦截。
- `●` 运行中，`!` 等待确认，`✓` 完成未读，`…` 正在连接；空闲时不显示状态圆点。

关闭整个客户端、卸载插件与关闭标签是不同操作。原生任务的存续仍由宿主负责。不同会话同时修改同一文件的冲突也仍由宿主与用户处理。

## 安装与回退

### 从 npm 安装和下载（推荐）

npm 页面：[dsh-session-tabs](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-session-tabs)。建议先在独立 profile 试用。

**Desktop：**在应用内插件管理器添加 `dsh-session-tabs`。

**Web：**使用 DSH 命令安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-tabs@0.1.6
```

如果使用 npm 手动管理 profile，先进入目标 profile 目录，再执行：

```sh
npm install dsh-session-tabs@0.1.6 --ignore-scripts
```

手动安装包后，还需在该 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 中启用 `dsh-session-tabs`，再刷新或重开 DSH；DSH 插件管理器和上面的 `dsh plugin` 命令会处理插件启用。

**只下载离线安装包：**在希望保存文件的目录运行：

```sh
npm pack dsh-session-tabs@0.1.6
```

会生成 `dsh-session-tabs-0.1.6.tgz`，可在 DSH 插件管理器中用该文件的完整路径添加。

### 从 GitHub 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:QIN-SMART/dsh-session-tabs
```

CLI 的 `--profile desktop` 是保留名称，不能套用上述 Web 命令。已有本地安装的用户可在目标 profile 的包管理器更新为 `dsh-session-tabs@0.1.6`，再完全退出并重开应用。开发用的模拟模型和测试 profile 不包含在 npm 包中。

临时回退：点击左栏底部的视图切换图标。完整移除：在目标 profile 的插件管理器移除 `dsh-session-tabs`，再刷新客户端；注入节点、样式、订阅与会话引用会清理。浏览器本地标签清单仍保留，可在需要时清除该站点的 `dsh-session-tabs.v1` 键。

## 状态和性能

标签顺序、启用偏好及活动身份存于 `localStorage['dsh-session-tabs.v1']`。刷新恢复标签；失效/归档 ID 会剔除。不同窗口同步偏好与标签身份，但不会抢占另一个窗口的当前会话。

只有一棵原生聊天视图。重开客户端时，非活动标签只恢复身份，不立即加载全部历史。已经访问过的标签保留轻量会话绑定，以沿用原生草稿/附件状态；其数量仍会影响内存，因此本插件不承诺无限标签或固定内存开销。草稿沿用原生机制，本插件不提供跨重启草稿持久化保证。

标签节点按身份复用，点击后立即更新标签；后台状态通知合并更新，浏览器存储写入短暂合并。实际会话内容仍由宿主原生导航加载，不能保证所有开关操作即时完成。实际验证范围与兼容性边界见 [验收说明](docs/validation.md)。

中心挂载点使用稳定 `data-slot="main"`，没有专用的官方标签栏插槽；宿主结构变化是主要兼容性风险。原生 sidebar/rightbar 插槽和右栏服务没有被替换或代理。顶栏入口仅转发到仍留在原处的原生控件，不搬动 React 管理的节点。若挂载失败，回滚新增节点并保留原生界面。

## 开发与验收

开发本仓库时：

```sh
node --test test/verify.mjs
node tools/start-test-profile.mjs --runtime /absolute/path/to/installed/@deepseek-ai/dsh --port 3096
# 可选复用已安装的右栏插件：--better-sidebar /absolute/path/to/dsh-better-sidebar
```

测试数据、profile 和日志仅写入本仓库 `.tmp/`。测试模型 `Local delayed echo` 本地流式输出约 60 秒，无网络模型请求；需在界面中明确选择该模型后发送合成任务。它仅用于验证并发、关闭和取消隔离。

真实 GUI 冒烟：`node tools/real-ui-check.mjs --url-file /absolute/path/to/test-url.txt --out docs/real-ui.png`，URL 文件仅保存隔离服务启动时给出的本机认证 URL，不提交。连接自己启动的 Electron 验收副本可用 `--connect-port 9346 --target-match <observed-main-target>`。`--edge-ui-check` 检查右栏开关；配合 `--handoff-ui-check` 在上述合成会话中检查底部按钮规格、连续点击和动画期间的位置。范围见 [验收说明](docs/validation.md)。

源码不需要构建，`lib/client.js` 即真实客户端产物；`npm pack` 只包含生产插件和说明，不包含测试模型、日志、profile、桌面副本或截图。

# dsh-open-workspace-any-app

在 DeepSeek Harness 的会话头部加一个「用其它应用打开」按钮：把当前工作区目录交给**任意应用** —— Zap、Qoder IDE、IntelliJ IDEA、Obsidian、HBuilderX，或任何你能写出启动方式的东西。

它和内置的 `open-in-app` 控件**并排共存**，互不遮挡。

## 交互

- **按钮上就是这个应用的图标。** 不用展开菜单、不用看提示文字，一眼知道点下去会开哪个应用。
- **记住上一次的选择。** 你上次用谁打开，下次按钮就是谁（跨会话、跨浏览器重启）。选中的那项在菜单里带勾。
- **在界面里增删应用。** 菜单底部「管理应用…」打开一个对话框：
  - 已经装好但还没进菜单的应用会列在「发现」区里，点一下即加入 —— 不需要知道 `.app` 路径。
  - 每一项都有 **移除** 按钮 —— **包括 `cordis.patch.yml` 里声明的应用**。
  - 移除的应用进入「已移除」区，可以一键放回。
- **对话框是固定视窗，不随列表变高。** 卡片最高 520px 且不超过窗口，列表在卡片内滚动 —— 一台机器装着几百个应用，「发现」列表**默认只显示前 6 条**，其余靠搜索。
- **顶部有搜索框。** 三段列表（菜单中 / 已移除 / 发现）**一起**被过滤：输入关键字后不再截断，匹配到的全部列出；清空就回到 6 条。

  增删都立刻生效，**不需要重启 DSH**。

> **Open the workspace directory in any app you declare**, beside the built-in open-in-app control.

---

## 为什么需要这个插件

DSH 自带的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-open-in-app` 解析的是一张**构建期固定**的目录表：

- `OPEN_IN_APP_CATALOG` 是模块级常量，**没有**出现在包的 `exports` 里，外部 `import` 不到；
- 解析器读取主机事实要经过模块私有的 `internals` 缝（`lib/types/internals.js` 里是 `{ catalog: {} }`，生产环境刻意留空），插件**无法注入**；
- 它的 `Config` 只接受三个超时字段，**没有**应用列表字段。

所以内置表里没写的应用（Zap、Qoder IDE、HBuilderX、Obsidian）既不能靠配置追加，也不能被插件从外部扩展。

插件**能做**的是：在旁边挂自己的路由、在会话头部注册自己的格子。这正是本包的做法。

| | 本插件 | 改内置白名单 |
|---|---|---|
| 你的编辑器能出现 | ✅ 独立按钮，列出你声明的全部应用 | ✅ 融进内置下拉 |
| 改动官方安装包 | ❌ 不动 | ✅ 要改 asar |
| 破坏代码签名 | ❌ 不破坏 | ✅ 破坏 |
| DSH 升级后 | ✅ 自动保留 | ❌ 每次重做 |
| 与内置菜单的关系 | 两个控件并列 | 一个控件 |

---

## 安装

在 DSH 的插件页安装本包，或让 Agent 通过 `plugin_manager` 安装。装完**重启 DSH**（新装的 JS 模块需要重新加载一代）。

安装后：

1. `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`，Profile 会把它作为一层 patch 应用；
2. patch 里的 `insert` 把 `dsh-open-workspace-any-app` 这一行加进 Profile；
3. `package.json` 的 `dsh.client` 声明让浏览器端发现 `exports["./client"]` 这个客户端产物。

## 配置

应用列表是**数据**，写在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `config.apps` 下，或你在 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖。

```yaml
- id: open-workspace-any-app
  name: dsh-open-workspace-any-app
  config:
    launchWatchMs: 1000
    apps:
      - id: zap                      # 稳定 id：启动请求和图标 URL 都用它寻址
        label: Zap                   # 菜单显示名；省略则用 id
        locators:                    # 按顺序尝试，第一个在此机器上验证通过的胜出
          - kind: app                # app = 按绝对路径的应用程序包
            paths:
              - /Applications/Zap.app
              - ~/Applications/Zap.app
```

### 定位器（locator）

| kind | 含义 | 默认启动方式 |
|---|---|---|
| `app` | 绝对路径下的应用程序包（macOS `.app`、Linux 应用目录） | `open`：macOS 用 `open -a <bundle> <dir>`，按身份交给 LaunchServices |
| `file` | 绝对路径下的可执行文件 | `argv`：直接运行，目录进 argv |
| `cli` | 通过 `PATH` 解析的命令（`ctx.subprocess.resolveExecutable`） | `argv` |
| `app-paths` | Windows 注册表 `App Paths`（先查 HKCU，再查 HKLM） | `argv` |

**第一个验证通过的定位器胜出**——所以「优先用 CLI，找不到再退回应用包」这样写就行：

```yaml
- id: idea
  label: IntelliJ IDEA
  iconBundle: /Applications/IntelliJ IDEA.app
  locators:
    - kind: cli
      command: idea                 # 优先：启动脚本，天然接受目录
    - kind: app
      paths: [/Applications/IntelliJ IDEA.app]
```

### 目录怎么传给应用

`launch` 省略时按定位器决定：`app` → `open`（按身份打开），其余 → `argv`（可执行文件）。

`argv` 形式下：

- 声明的参数里**没有** `{path}` → 目录**追加**到末尾（编辑器 CLI 想要的形状）：`idea <dir>`；
- 某个参数含 `{path}` → 在该处**替换**：`--cd={path}` → `--cd=/work/project`。

列表顺序 = 菜单顺序。`label` 省略时用 `id`。

### `platforms` 覆盖

`platforms` 里的某个平台**整体替换** `locators`（而不是合并）——和内置目录表把「每平台 spec」当作该平台的完整答案一致：

```yaml
- id: editor
  label: Editor
  locators:
    - kind: app
      paths: [/Applications/Mac.app]
  platforms:
    linux:
      - kind: cli
        command: editor
```

### 图标

- `iconBundle`：包路径，取其 `.icns` 转成 128px PNG（`plutil` + `sips`，macOS 自带）；
- `iconPath`：直接提供的图片文件，按扩展名给 media type 原样送出；
- `app` 定位器在 macOS 上**默认**用自己的包当图标来源。

图标是装饰：取不到就 404，浏览器画一个通用字形，**不会**让菜单项消失。

---

## 安全

每个路由都先向组合的 `connection` 服务要一次拒绝判定（`requestRejection`），和内置控件一致：

- **Host/Origin 栅栏**挡住 DNS rebinding 与跨站调用；
- **浏览器认证**（登录 token cookie）在任何目录、图标、启动可达之前就拦下调用方。

在此之上，启动路由在**线缆层**再校验一次请求体：`application/json`、64 KiB 上限、`app`/`path` 必须是字符串、id 必须已解析、路径必须是**绝对路径且指向真实存在的目录**。所以不可信的调用方无法把这个路由变成「运行任意路径」。

`connection` 是**必需**注入：缺了它就是一个没有栅栏的「启动本地应用」端点。（缺少时路由一律 503，而不是无栅栏放行。）

启动的子进程拿到**抹掉凭据的环境**：`*KEY*`/`*PASSWORD*`/`*SECRET*`/`*TOKEN*`、`DSH_*`、`NODE_OPTIONS`、`NODE_PATH` 都不会传下去。

---

## 行为细节

- **一次解析，长期复用**：目录在第一次需要它的请求时解析一次，之后的菜单打开、页面刷新都不再重新探测。
- **装了什么才显示什么**：某台机器上解析不出来的条目，直接不出现在菜单里——一份配置可以服务多台机器。
- **单个条目坏掉不拖垮菜单**：某个定位器抛错（路径不可读、seam 异常）只让**那一条**按「未安装」处理。
- **解析有预算**：`resolveBudgetMs`（默认 15s）到点就用已完成的部分作答，并在响应里带 `truncated: true`，而不是无限等下去。
- **SSH 会话不探测**：远端没有本地 GUI 可开，目录直接为空。
- **启动失败只在观察窗内判定**：子进程在 `launchWatchMs`（默认 1s）后仍在运行 → 计为启动成功并 `unref`（编辑器整个窗口生命周期都在前台）；窗口内非零退出 → 502。

### 配置项

| 字段 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `apps` | `[]` | 声明的应用，按菜单顺序 |
| `probeTimeoutMs` | `10000` | 单个定位器解析命令的超时 |
| `iconTimeoutMs` | `10000` | 图标提取命令的超时 |
| `launchWatchMs` | `1000` | 每次启动的早期失败观察窗 |
| `resolveBudgetMs` | `15000` | 单次解析总预算 |
| `storeDir` | `<DSH home>/open-workspace-any-app` | 界面添加的应用存放目录（测试/隔离用） |

重复的 `id` 会在组合期直接**报错**（而不是让后一个静默不可达）。

---

## 无头验证

```bash
npm test                  # 等价于 node --test 'tests/*.test.js'
npm run verify:geometry   # 可选：用无头 Chrome 量对话框的真实布局
```

覆盖：定位器链与平台覆盖、`~`/`${VAR}` 展开、启动 argv 构造（追加 vs `{path}` 替换）、三种 `open`/`argv` 启动路径、解析预算截断、三条路由的注册路径与全部拒绝分支、栅栏缺失/拒绝/放行、重复 id 报错、客户端产物的注册契约与双语字典平衡，以及**真实 HTTP 请求驱动的真实进程启动**（`/usr/bin/true` 成功、`/usr/bin/false` 得 502、不存在的目录得 404）。

对话框另有断言：长扫描在**空搜索时只画 6 行**并提示剩余数量、短列表不提示、查询同时过滤三段并解除截断、查无结果与扫描失败各自的文案、空列表不画搜索框、卡片带着 `max-height` 上限与可滚动正文。客户端测试用的 React 替身**遵守依赖数组**（否则扫描 effect 每次渲染都重跑、搜索框刚输入就被清空，那是浏览器里不会出现的状态），`client.render.test.js` 则用真 React + `react-dom/server` 渲染，确保元素树与 hook 元数没漂。

**几何**是另一回事，上面两条都管不到它：一张画了 200 行、`max-height: none` 的卡片，元素树每个属性都对，只是**布局**不对；`node --test` 没有布局引擎。所以 `npm run verify:geometry` 用无头 Chrome 量真实布局 —— 它从**已安装的 DSH** 里取出真实设计令牌、真实的 `Modal`/`Input` 样式表，再执行 `lib/client.js` 拿到它真正注入的那张样式表，量 4 种视口 × 9 条断言（卡片有上限、卡片在窗口内、按钮与搜索框在屏上、正文可滚动、搜索框吸顶、正文可收缩、滚动条归正文、搜索框撑满）。卡片高度从 **7611px** 变成 **520px**。

这个脚本是**可选**的（要 Chrome + 装好的 DSH），不进 `npm test`。它的断言做过反向验证：把 `max-height` 与 `overflow-y` 去掉，14 条断言立刻失败。

两个坑记在这里：`--dump-dom` 早于异步帧完成，量尺寸要**同步 + 强制回流**，别用 `requestAnimationFrame` 链（否则会把正常工作的 `sticky` 判成坏的）；读 asar 的头部长度要对齐到 4 字节边界（`16 + align4(headerSize)`），差 2 字节就会让每个样式表开头多一个字符，浏览器随即丢掉第一条规则，量出来的 `max-height` 就成了 `none`。

---

## 为什么依赖面这么窄

本包只 import 一个主机依赖 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`（用于 `Config` schema），其余主机能力都通过 cordis 上下文取：`webServer`、`connection`、`subprocess`。

这不是洁癖。插件从**它被安装进的 Profile** 解析 `@deepseek-ai/*`，而那个 Profile 未必是运行中的应用启动时用的那棵树——两者可以是不同版本。多一个跨包 import，就多一次版本错位让插件在 import 阶段直接失败的机会。所以本包把本来会 import 的两个能力各用几行自己实现了：

- `scrubbedParentEnv()` —— 启动子进程的环境清洗；
- `launchedThroughSsh()` —— SSH 会话判定。

## 交互实现

### 记住选择

用平台自己的快照 store 持久化，写到 `localStorage` 的 `dsh.open-workspace-any-app.choice`：

```js
store.createSnapshotStore('', { persist: { name: 'dsh.open-workspace-any-app.choice' } })
```

这是内置控件同款机制（它用 `dsh.open-in-app.choice`）。存储不可用时（隐私模式、配额）自动退化成内存态，**不会抛错**。

只有**主机确认接受**的启动才会被记住 —— 把一个失败的启动写进存储，会让下次打开时按钮指向一个坏掉的应用。

被记住的应用如果已经不在菜单里了（比如你把它移除了），按钮回退到第一个可用应用，而不是变空。

> 内置控件在这里有个坑：它把持久化的 id 拿 `APP_LABEL_KEY` 硬编码字典过滤，未知 id 会被**静默丢弃**。本插件不过滤，所以自己加的应用不会被吞掉。

### 增删应用

**添加**走对话框里的扫描列表：`GET /discover` 扫描 `/Applications`、`/System/Applications`、`~/Applications`，会排除掉**已经解析成功**的应用，所以「可加的」和「菜单里已有的」不重叠。「发现」区里每一行自带一个添加按钮，点一下即加入 —— 不需要知道 `.app` 路径，也没有平台差异。

**删除**是这个版本修掉的核心问题。它记录为「隐藏」，而不是去改配置：

- 早期版本只允许删除界面添加的应用，结果是**最可能在屏幕上的那些（profile 自带的 5 个声明应用）一个都删不掉**。菜单项能不能删，是关于**菜单**的问题，不是关于这个条目写在哪儿的问题。
- 所以删除统一记为 id 列表 `hidden`。手写的配置**从不被改写**（插件改写操作员的文档，下次手工编辑就得和机器写的行做合并），而且这样删除是**可逆的** —— 对话框能把它们放回。

存储文件 `<DSH home>/open-workspace-any-app/apps.json`：

```json
{
  "version": 2,
  "apps":   [{ "id": "obsidian", "label": "Obsidian", "path": "/Applications/Obsidian.app" }],
  "hidden": ["qoder"]
}
```

`apps` 是界面添加的，`hidden` 是要从菜单隐藏的 id（来自任一来源）。版本 1 只有 `apps`，读到时升级为「没隐藏任何东西」，而不是丢弃。

两份来源在读取时合并（`mergeCatalog`）：手写条目在前且保持顺序；界面条目的 id 或包路径若已被手写条目占用则丢弃 —— 手写的那行优先，绝不静默遮蔽。

移除一个来源里已经没有的 id 是无害的，也不会出现在「可恢复」里（没有东西可恢复）。

### 图标

- `iconBundle`：包路径，取其 `.icns` 转成 128px PNG（`plutil` + `sips`，macOS 自带）；
- `iconPath`：直接提供的图片文件，按扩展名给 media type 原样送出；
- `app` 定位器在 macOS 上**默认**用自己的包当图标来源。

图标是装饰：取不到就 404，浏览器画一个通用字形，**不会**让菜单项消失。

---

## 安全

每个路由都先向组合的 `connection` 服务要一次拒绝判定（`requestRejection`），和内置控件一致：

- **Host/Origin 栅栏**挡住 D

plugins.readme_text:
# DeepSeek 网页聊天 · DSH 插件

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%3E%3D0.2.0--rc.2-4D6BFE)
![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-19%20suites%20%C2%B7%200%20deps-brightgreen)

把 **chat.deepseek.com**（DeepSeek 网页版）的对话记录同步进 DSH 的 Web 界面，并在同一个窗口里
直接继续聊天——不用再切到浏览器。左侧面板栏多出一个「聊天」图标，会话标题栏多出一个
**聊天 / 工作** 切换开关，和 ChatGPT 桌面版的 聊天 ⇄ 工作 是一个意思。

> 想先看「产品向」的介绍（亮点、架构图、三步安装）？见 👉 [产品介绍.md](产品介绍.md)。

![聊天模式：会话列表在最左侧栏的「聊天」页里，正文在右侧，标题栏右侧是 聊天 ⇄ 工作 开关](docs/chat-mode.png)

*聊天模式。会话记录住在**最左侧那一栏**的「聊天」页里（与「任务」「频道」并列），中间是对话正文，
右上角就是 **聊天 ⇄ 工作** 开关——切回工作，中间立刻换回 DSH 的 Agent 会话。*

```
┌─ 侧栏 ─┬────────────── 聊天面板 ──────────────┐
│  ▣ 插件 │  [ 聊天 | 工作 ]   ⟳ 同步  ＋ 新对话  │
│  ▤ 聊天 │  ┌───────────────────────────────┐  │
│         │  │  你: …                        │  │
│ 任务 聊天 │  │  DeepSeek: …                  │  │
│  搜索…   │  │  ▍ 生成中…                    │  │
│  会话 A  │  └───────────────────────────────┘  │
│  会话 B  │                                   │
└─────────┴───────────────────────────────────┘
   ↑ 会话列表在最左栏的「聊天」页里，和「任务」并列
```

- **聊天模式** = 这个插件面板，走你自己的 chat.deepseek.com 账号，历史记录与网页版一致。
- **工作模式** = DSH 原本的 Agent 会话（工具、文件、终端……），两者互不干扰。
- 切换只改变中间显示哪一栏，**不会**新建或销毁会话，来回切是瞬时的。

## 安装

三种装法，任选其一。装完都要**重启 DSH**：宿主半边是 ESM，只有新进程才会加载新的代际。

**① 插件市场（推荐）** —— 装一次市场，之后在 DSH 里「设置 → 插件市场」搜索本插件一键安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dshmarket   # 需要 dsh web 0.1.0-rc.6 及以上
# 然后重启 dsh web
```

**② 命令行 / 插件页** —— 包名、Git 地址、tarball 或本地绝对路径都接受：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-deepseek-web-chat
# 或未发布时直接指向仓库 / 本目录：
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:HAN-050917/dsh-plugin-dsweb-harness
dsh plugin --profile desktop add C:/Users/p/Documents/deepseek-harness/default-workspace/dsh-deepseek-web-chat
```

> 桌面版需先初始化一次 profile，并**完全退出**后再执行 `dsh plugin --profile desktop …`。
> 也可以让 DSH 里的 Agent 执行：`plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=<本目录绝对路径>`。

**③ 本仓库开发** —— 本目录以 `link:` 方式挂在桌面配置里（`dsh.profile.bundles` 的最后一项），
所以**改工作区代码就是改插件**：客户端半边刷新页面即可生效，宿主半边（`lib/index.js`、
`lib/deepseek.js`）必须重启 DSH。没有构建步骤，`lib/client.js` 是手写产物、由宿主直接发布。

```powershell
# 跑测试（19 个套件，零依赖，用 DSH 自带 Node）
node test-surface.mjs   # …test-*.mjs 都在包根目录
```

## 配置令牌（一次性）

插件需要你自己的网页版登录令牌才能读你的对话。令牌只存在本机，只用于向
`chat.deepseek.com` 发请求。

1. 浏览器打开并登录 <https://chat.deepseek.com>。
2. `F12` → **Console**，粘贴回车：

   ```js
   JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('userToken')).value
   ```

3. 复制打印出来的令牌，切到 DSH 的「聊天」面板，粘贴进输入框，点 **保存并验证**。

输入框也接受整段 `Authorization: Bearer …`，或直接粘贴 `userToken` 的整段 JSON——会自动解开。

> **令牌会过期。** 过期后面板顶部会出现红色提示，按上面三步重新取一次即可。
> 点「清除令牌」会删除本机文件。

令牌存放位置：`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-deepseek-web-chat\vault.json`（仅当前用户可读）。

## 功能

| 功能 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 会话同步 | 拉取网页版的会话列表（最多 500 条），带标题与时间 |
| 历史回看 | 打开任一会话，读取完整的问答记录 |
| 本地缓存 | 同步结果落在 `cache.json`，离线也能看，最多缓存 200 个会话 |
| 继续聊天 | 在已有会话里接着发消息，网页版刷新后能看到（同一条会话） |
| 新建会话 | 「＋ 新对话」在 DeepSeek 侧建一个新会话再发消息 |
| 深度思考 / 联网搜索 | 对应网页版的两个开关 |
| 模型选择 | `default` / `expert` / `vision` |
| 流式输出 | 逐字返回；思考内容折叠显示在回答上方 |
| 自动续写 | 上游把长回答截断时（`INCOMPLETE` / `auto_continue`）自动调 `/chat/continue` 接着写，最多 8 轮 |
| 可中断 | 生成中点「停止」，会中断上游请求 |
| 添加附件 | 点 composer 左侧「＋」选择文件，或把文件拖到聊天面板；上传后可移除附件，也支持仅发送文件 |
| 拖拽上传 | 拖入文件时显示整窗投放提示；多个文件会逐个开始上传（最多 10 个、单个 100 MB） |
| 网页版附件协议 | Host 获取专属 PoW、multipart 上传并轮询至可用；附件 ID 随同回合发送到网页版接口 |
| 按文件内容追问 | 附件留在会话里：首轮之后继续提问，Host 仍会把该会话的附件 ID 一并送到上游，所以模型始终读得到文档内容（上游自己**不**保留文件，见下） |
| 文件解析状态 | 上传后 chip 显示 解析中… / 解析失败 / 文件大小；解析未完成时发送会被拦下（`409`），不会再出现「发出去了却一片空白」 |

拖拽时可把一个或多个文件放到聊天面板内（**窗口任意位置**都可投放，见「拖放不白屏」），面板会显示投放提示并逐个上传；也可使用输入框旁的「＋」选择文件。上传成功后附件以 chips 显示，发送后仍留在 composer 里：这份对话一直带着这些文件，因此后续追问不需要重新上传，想断开时点 chip 上的 × 即可（Host 会照做，见 `/chat` 的 `detachFiles`）。即使不输入文字也可发送附件。当前限制为最多 10 个附件、单文件 100 MB。
| 聊天气泡 | 你的提问靠右（气泡）、DeepSeek 的回答靠左（正文），一轮问答之间有留白与一条细分割线，上下对话一眼能分开 |
| 侧栏「聊天」页签 | 侧栏 任务 / 频道 之间多一个「聊天」页签，专放网页版对话记录，与工作区会话列表互不干扰（第三方页签行，检测不到时自动退回普通面板，见下） |
| 只有一份列表 | 对话记录只住在**最左侧那一栏**的「聊天」页里，面板中间**不再**画第二份。进聊天模式时侧栏自动切到「聊天」、回工作模式自动切回「任务」；若侧栏正停在别的页签（或折叠了），面板会提示列表在哪，并给一个一键切回的按钮 |
| 干净正文 | 搜索簿记（`搜索到 N 个网页`、`DEEP_SEARCH`、工具调用记账）与免责声明 `TIP` 不会混进正文；`[reference:N]` / `[citation:N]` 引用标记会被剥掉（网页端把它渲染成可点击芯片，这里没有来源面板，留着只是噪音） |

### 测试与预览工具

`tools/` 下的脚本不进包运行时，只服务于开发期核对：

| 脚本 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `lift.mjs` | 从 `lib/client.js` 里**提升**出真实函数源码段（括号配平需跳过字符串/模板串/注释/正则字面量），供测试与预览复用 |
| `build-preview.mjs` | 渲染合成样本，输出 `_preview/preview.html`，用无头浏览器量折叠态几何 |
| `build-expanded-preview.mjs` | 把 `useState` 桩成 `expanded=true`，输出展开态 |
| `build-live-preview.mjs` | 拉真实 `/sessions` + `/messages` 渲染，输出 `_preview/live.html` |
| `dump-theme-tokens.mjs` / `extract-theme-css.mjs` | 从主题包里导出 token 词汇表与 CSS，喂给 `test-style.mjs` |

三个预览脚本都**调用** `lift.mjs` 提升出来的真实函数，而不是复制一份标记：复制的那一份已经漂移过一次
（其中一份扫描器缺正则字符类处理，markdown 段被截断在 `{2,}` 上）。

### 浏览器半边

`lib/client.js` 走 DSH 的 lazy-CJS 协议（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({id, factory})`），
**没有构建步骤**，外部依赖只有平台自带的 `react`。它占了三个官方 slot，并额外接了一个
第三方页签（见下）：

| Slot | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `sidebar.panellist`（list，`id: 'deepseek-web-chat'`） | 左侧面板栏的图标；面板栏自己画按钮，插件只画图形 |
| `main`（keyed，`key: 'deepseek-web-chat'`） | 聊天面板本体 |
| `conversation.header.leading`（single，原本空着） | 标题前的 **聊天 / 工作** 开关，没开会话时也在 |

（另有 `ctx.inject(['shortcuts'], …)` 注册的两个切换命令，见下。）

模式切换用的是 DSH 自己的原语：`ctx.layout.selectPanel('deepseek-web-chat')` 进聊天，
`selectPanel(null)` 回 Agent 会话（`null` 就是「回到 Conversation」）。所以不需要任何
DOM 技巧，也不会盖掉自带界面。

#### 「表面（surface）」轴：从 ChatGPT 桌面端反推来的四个机制

聊天 / 工作在这份实现里是一个**独立的表面轴**，既不等于 Agent 的工作模式，也不挂在某个
会话上。这一点是照着 ChatGPT/Codex 桌面端做的——那边 `codexAppMode: 'chat' | 'work' |
'codex'` 是应用级表面，而 plan/default 只是**单轮**的元数据。值得抄的不是它的字段名，而是
下面四条行为（都能在 `test-surface.mjs` 里单独验证）：

| 机制 | ChatGPT 桌面端 | 这里 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 选择独立于会话持久化 | `localStorage['home-composer-mode-v1']` | `localStorage['dsh-deepseek-web-chat.surface.v1']`，重载后回到你离开的那一面 |
| 幂等切换 | `if (i === n && !a) return;` | `surfaceStore.select()` 先过 `isSameSurface()`，点当前那一面不重新导航 |
| 先持久化再导航 | 存完再改路由，路由变化才执行切换 | 先写 localStorage，再 `selectPanel` |
| 每个模式各记一个位置 | 记住 `location`，回来时恢复 | `…locations.v1` 里记 `{sessionId}`，回来时重开那个会话；**记的那个会话没了就开新对话**，绝不回到过期线程 |

- **列表还没同步时不能判断「位置没了」**。那会儿「查不到」只是「还不知道」，当时就决定的话

  （`pendingChatRestore`），而不是靠猜。
